title: Room of antiques with a Singer sewing machine and a round window
place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

as_told.title: Small being shows Mario a room of old human objects
as_told.place_text: Aboard craft (items like those of his home in Port Arthur, Texas)

plain: Mario Woods, who says he was a guard at a US nuclear weapons site, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1977 near South Dakota he was taken aboard a craft and shown a room full of old things, including a Singer sewing machine on its table, with a round window, and he has made drawings of it. In a later telling he adds that a small being led him there and let him look around, and that the objects looked like the ones in his childhood home in Port Arthur, Texas. If true, his takers knew his own past closely.
